subject.title: Agent loop allows simulated tool calls instead of enforcing real tool invocation

question: What should ordinary agent turns do when the model emits text that simulates a tool call instead of a structured tool call?
rationale: The remaining work is not a single mechanical bugfix: stricter defaults, parser-specific promotion, fail-closed behavior, and provider/local-model compatibility have security and upgrade tradeoffs that need maintainer intent.

options.title: Define a scoped strict policy
options.body: Keep current warning and bounded repair as compatibility defaults, then add maintainer-approved strict fail-closed or retry behavior for configured agent/provider paths with tests and docs.

options.title: Fail closed by default
options.body: Treat any tool-call-shaped prose in ordinary agent turns as an immediate agent failure, accepting higher compatibility risk for stronger safety.

options.title: Keep warning-only behavior
options.body: Close the issue as a documented local-model limitation and rely on provider `tool_choice` settings plus existing sanitization.

recommendation.title: Define a scoped strict policy
recommendation.body: Keep current warning and bounded repair as compatibility defaults, then add maintainer-approved strict fail-closed or retry behavior for configured agent/provider paths with tests and docs.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent fake-tool diagnostics and local-model docs are the closest current-main policy surface for deciding the next behavior.
